rationale.complete: Round 1 done: pre-registered onset rule, nine-scenario synthetic validation, 19 non-holdout periods with per-period verdicts, scorecard, frozen and dry-run holdout script. The holdout test and the per-turn re-test are not run.
rationale.faithfulness: The critical-slowing-down signature is absent: autocorrelation never rises (AUC 0.42). The composite beats placebos only at 15 min and fragilely (0.62 [0.51, 0.76], n = 8) and fails at 30 min. Rivals fit better (onsets out of nowhere; link announcements). C = D = H = 0; F = 1 shows the method can barely work at village N.
rationale.usefulness: A clear, quantified negative an operator can act on (don't build CSD dashboards for 10-15-agent swarms), measured operating characteristics, and a rate-matched-shift check for any alarm. The positive pointer (links precede pile-ons) is post hoc.

one_line: Generic early-warning signals do not forecast LLM-swarm pile-ons: autocorrelation never rises, and alarms time no better than chance.
